subject: Schmidt Logistik - vendor set-up and PO / VAT details
messages:
From: Ingrid Bauer <ingrid.bauer@schmidt-logistik.de>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: ap@schmidt-logistik.de
Date: 2026-01-22T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding - what we need from Redwood

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — Schmidt Logistik is moving forward with procurement for the pilot integration. Our AP team needs to register Redwood Inference as a supplier before we can issue POs and process the first payment. Please can you provide the following items so we can set you up in our SAP vendor master?

Required for registration:
- Official company name and legal entity: full registered name and address
- VAT / tax ID (EU) and confirmation whether reverse-charge applies
- Billing address for invoices (and whether invoices should be emailed to ap@schmidt-logistik.de)
- SEPA bank details (IBAN + BIC) and confirmation of account name
- W-9 or equivalent tax doc if applicable for non-EU entities
- Sample invoice PDF or invoice template showing PO number placement
- Contact for accounting for any invoice queries

There is a vendor portal entry for Redwood; once the required files are attached and forms completed we can confirm the supplier code and send the first PO. Deadline for the pilot PO is 2026-02-15.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — copying our AP mailbox for checklist confirmation.

Best,
Ingrid Bauer
Head of Procurement
Schmidt Logistik GmbH
ingrid.bauer@schmidt-logistik.de

--
Attachment: supplier_registration_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Ingrid Bauer <ingrid.bauer@schmidt-logistik.de>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, ap@schmidt-logistik.de
Date: 2026-01-23T11:07:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - what we need from Redwood

Hi Ingrid — thanks, and great to hear the pilot timeline. I've looped in Finance (Monica) and Sales Ops (Lauren) to get you a compact packet. Quick answers inline below and files attached.

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (registered in Delaware)
  Legal address: 400 Redwood Way, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA
- VAT / Tax: US entity; we do not have an EU VAT registration. For EU customers, we typically invoice without VAT and annotate reverse-charge when appropriate (please confirm with your tax team).
- Billing address: Redwood Inference, Inc., Attn: Accounts Receivable, 400 Redwood Way, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Invoices: Please send invoices to ap@schmidt-logistik.de and to invoices@redwood.com (we will also push to our finance system)
- Bank details: SEPA transfers are accepted. See attached Redwood_SEPA_Form.pdf for IBAN/BIC and account name.
- Sample invoice: attached sample_invoice_SCH.pdf showing PO field placement (please confirm PO number format).
- Accounting contact: monica.patel@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0123

Attachments included: Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_EU_VAT_Declaration.pdf, Redwood_SEPA_Form.pdf, sample_invoice_SCH.pdf

Next steps: Lauren — can you confirm the PO format we expect from Schmidt (prefix / length)? Rishi — FYI, we should ensure any pilot discount or credit is reflected on the invoice line items so AP can reconcile.

Markus Klein
VP, Business Operations
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, Ingrid Bauer <ingrid.bauer@schmidt-logistik.de>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, ap@schmidt-logistik.de
Date: 2026-01-27T14:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - what we need from Redwood

Hi all,

Thanks for the packet, Markus — a couple of quick clarifications from procurement perspective:

1) PO number format: Schmidt PO format needs a 10-digit numeric code starting with 20 (e.g., 20XXXXXXXX). If a contract reference is provided we can also include that in the invoice reference field but AP requires the 10-digit PO on the invoice top line.
2) Reverse-charge: Ingrid, our tax team said they will accept invoices without VAT if the vendor confirms reverse-charge. Markus, please confirm whether Redwood will include the note: "VAT reverse charge applies per EU Directive" and include our VAT reference field (we'll provide it once portal is complete).
3) Remittance: SEPA payment runs weekly on Wednesdays; please confirm cut-off for receiving funds.

Also adding Rishi to confirm pilot discount — if there is a one-time credit, please include it as a separate line item with unit price negative and reference SCH-2026-0147.

We can proceed to create the vendor code once the portal form is filled and the W-9 / VAT note attached. I uploaded the vendor portal draft and invited Markus to complete the supplier profile: https://schmidt-logistik.vendorportal.de/registration/confirm?ref=SCH-2026-0147

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
